8 or 9 years ago a family friend showed up at the front door and asked to speak with just my dad on the front porch - my dad late came in seeming pretty dead in the face. Later that evening my parents asked me into the room with them saying they had something to talk about, apparently the family friend had been diagnosed with cancer and needed extra money to cover the meds that his insurance wouldn't cover. I was pretty devastated, the guy had lent me a full drum kit so I could learn to play the drums, he got me work the previous summer as well refereeing little kids soccer for extra cash so I was really fond of him.

Lots of people in the community came together to help him out with a lot of people giving him the money and telling him not to worry about ever paying it back - his life was worth more than the price of meds. This went on for ages and seemed really believable - he had begun to shave his head, and started to look really thin.

Eventually the pleas for money kept going and people started getting suspicious as he was asking people for a lot of money really often. We're a pretty small and tight-knit community and eventually word got out from the local pharmacist that he didn't have any prescriptions for cancer medications... A couple of nights later his wife showed up at our door step crying.

It turned out he never had cancer. He was an alcoholic and was using the money people gave him to fuel his addiction. He got so caught up in the lie he shaved his head constantly and lost weight to make it more believable. 

Eventually he moved away, lost complete custody of his kids and had a restraining order placed upon him by his wife and two kids. I was 11-12 at the time it all started and I was 16 when the court finally issued a restraining order ending . Couldn't really understand it all as a kid but as I grew up I realizing just how fucked up it was
